prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to summon, interact with, or temporarily hide your pet right from your desktop toolbar.", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide pet", "Got It"]
1: ["Select your companion personality"]
2: ["Checking Your Pet Cloud Sync", "We check if your existing pet save data is active before signing in so you never lose progress.", "Cloud Protection Active", "Continue to Sign In"]
3: ["Select Your Onboarding Journey", "Choose how you want to discover and build your new desktop friend."]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Environment", "Initializing graphics rendering engine", "Spawning pet avatar on desktop overlay"]
5: ["Signing into an existing account safely syncs and preserves your existing pet progress.", "Safe Account Sync"]
6: ["Ensure photos have clear lighting and sharp angles to prevent pet custom generation failures."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your desktop companion anytime to open quick controls, change settings, or start a chat."]
8: ["Complete onboarding to unlock an exclusive starter outfit for your desktop pet!", "Free Starter Gift Included"]
9: ["Feel free to minimize this window while we finish rendering. We will notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop.", "Play alert tone when ready"]
